heading, At CardMedic, We are on a mission to make healthcare communication more accessible, empowering every patient to have a voice. Our ethos is focussed on improving patient understanding, safety, experience, and quality of care, while striving to reduce health inequalities., level 5
We believe in making healthcare information accessible and understandable for all.
So we built a digital "One Stop Communication Shop" to empower staff and patients to communicate across any barrier.
Now we want to become a movement for change.
end of link, Find out more

CardMedic is an innovative and multi award-winning language platform and app designed by clinicians to improve communication between healthcare staff and patients, across any barrier – whether that’s visual, hearing or cognitive impairment, a language barrier, or PPE (personal protective equipment). CardMedic encompasses 1000s of instantly accessible clinical interactions written for patients on any device in 50+ languages, sign language, easy read & text-to-speech. When further dialogue is needed, quickly connect with the right interpreter at the point of need.

Our founders, Rachael and Tim, were inspired to create CardMedic after reading a news article about a critically ill Covid-19 survivor, terrified when unable to understand healthcare staff through the PPE barrier. This struck a chord. It highlighted the daily struggles and health inequalities faced by patients with communication challenges, over hundreds of years. Stuck abroad at the height of the pandemic and unable to return home to work on the frontline, CardMedic was established to ensure that every patient can be offered healthcare information in a format they understand.
